title: Interviewing Havana syndrome victims
place_text: Cuba, Russia, China, Austria, Germany, Switzerland, United States

tellings.quote:
>> Yeah. We've been interviewing victims of
Havana syndrome. Yeah.

plain: Chris Gilbert, a guest, tells Michels that he and Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, have been interviewing victims of Havana syndrome, the unexplained headaches, dizziness and brain injuries reported by American diplomats and spies, from Cuba, Russia, China, Austria, Germany, Switzerland and the United States. He mentions it in passing as work they are doing now. The interviews matter because the cause of these injuries is still unknown, and some suspect an unusual weapon.
